visit-track.description: Log every Tier-2 visit event before it is sent (pageview, heartbeat, section, project_open, print, exit) with its payload
visit-track.cleanup: Remove once the tracking self-application dry run passes and the ledger is trusted

filter-roll.description: Replay the archive's intro industry roll on every load, bypassing the once-per-session sessionStorage gate (a hard refresh does NOT clear it)
filter-roll.cleanup: Remove once the roll's length and chip swell are signed off on device

chl-zoom.description: Log campaign-highlights tap-to-read: touch/fine-pointer switch, dialog open (image src) and close

scroll-hud.description: On-screen scroll state for tuning the walkthrough dwell on a phone: scrollY, velocity, the stable viewport's rest state, the act's segment + stop + fraction (section.walkthroughPlace), and a note per rest with the flick's reach and peak speed
scroll-hud.cleanup: Remove once the elastic dwell (iOS Phase 3) is tuned and shipped

scroll-trace.description: With scroll-hud: record the HUD's state every frame and scroll event, plus every HUD note, and POST it to /trace (only the iOS probe server answers; it appends .claude/iosjank/probe/reports/trace-<session>.jsonl) so simulator and phone runs leave a frame-level record
scroll-trace.cleanup: Remove with scroll-hud once the elastic dwell is tuned and shipped

hero-trace.description: Sample the hero's script-driven styles every frame — the Key Results floor, grid and heading-group transforms, the values' opacity, the label and heading colour alpha, the title fade, the scene overlay and crossfade, Ken Burns and the focal pan (window.HeroTrace.sample()); with scroll-trace every frame record carries it as `h`, so a simulator or phone run measures held frames and jumps per property (.claude/iosjank/tools/hero-step-tally.js)
hero-trace.cleanup: Remove with scroll-trace once the touch transitions (iOS Phase 2 tail) are signed off on Jakob's phone

media-warm.description: Log the eager background loader (media-warm.js): each lazy image promoted, its distance from the eye line and the in-flight count; pauses while the reader moves; done
media-warm.cleanup: Remove once the loader's order and pause are verified on Jakob's phone (iOS Phase 4)

template-warnings.description: Warn when a bare {{path}} or {{{path}}} fails to resolve during a build render (path missing from data — explicit nulls and block-helper existence checks stay silent)
template-warnings.cleanup: Permanent build tripwire — keep unless the template engine is replaced
